info.name: List or found CIM Incident objects

params.name: priority
params.description: The priority (ITIL) is based on the assessment of the impact and urgency of how quickly the CIM Incident should be resolved after evaluation by the Seller of the impact of the CIM Incident.

params.name: severity
params.description: The severity or impact (ITIL) of the CIM Incident as evaluated by the Seller.

params.name: impact
params.description: The type of impact observed by the Buyer.

params.name: incidentType
params.description: The presumed cause of the CIM Incident as evaluated by the Seller.

params.name: status
params.description: The current status of the CIM Incident

params.name: relatedEntityId
params.description: ID of a related entity that this CIM Incident is related to and is present in the `relatedEntity` list

params.name: relatedEntityType
params.description: Type of a related entity that this CIM Incident is related to and is present in the `relatedEntity` list

params.name: creationDate.gt
params.description: The date on which the CIM Incident was created - greater than

params.name: creationDate.lt
params.description: The date on which CIM Incident was created - lower than

params.name: situationStartDate.gt
params.description: The date when the CIM Incident was first identified, for example via error logs - greater than

params.name: situationStartDate.lt
params.description: The date when the CIM Incident was first identified, for example via error logs - lower than

params.name: expectedClosedDate.gt
params.description: The date provided by the Seller to indicate when the CIM Incident is expected to be closed - greater than

params.name: expectedClosedDate.lt
params.description: The date provided by the Seller to indicate when the CIM Incident is expected to be closed - lower than

params.name: closedDate.gt
params.description: The date the CIM Incident status was set to closed by the Seller - greater than

params.name: closedDate.lt
params.description: The date the CIM Incident status was set to closed by the Seller - lower than

params.name: buyerId
params.description: The unique identifier of the organization that is acting as the a Buyer. MUST be specified in the request only when the requester represents more than one Buyer.

params.name: sellerId
params.description: The unique identifier of the organization that is acting as the Seller. MUST be specified in the request only when responding entity represents more than one Seller.

params.name: offset
params.description: Requested index for start of resources to be provided in response

params.name: limit
params.description: Requested number of resources to be provided in response

items.docs: The Buyer requests a list of CIM Incidents from the Seller based on a set of specified filter criteria. The Seller returns a summarized list of CIM Incidents.
